dept.dentistry.name: Department of Dentistry
dept.dentistry.head_speech: I am pleased and honored to welcome you to the Department of Dentistry at Al-Amarah University College—an academic institution that, since its establishment, has strived to provide high-quality university education that keeps pace with scientific advances and responds to the needs of the community in our beloved city of Amarah. The Department of Dentistry is one of the most vital departments in the college, playing an essential role in preparing qualified medical professionals equipped with the scientific knowledge, practical skills, and professional ethics required to practice dentistry with efficiency and responsibility. The department works to provide an integrated educational environment that combines theoretical study with practical training inside laboratories and teaching clinics, with a commitment to utilizing modern diagnostic and therapeutic technologies. Furthermore, the department places special emphasis on enhancing students' research capabilities and encouraging scientific thinking and teamwork, helping shape doctors capable of keeping pace with scientific progress while serving patients on solid human and professional foundations. Our vision in the Department of Dentistry stems from our belief that medical education is not merely the transmission of knowledge, but a mission and a responsibility toward society. Guided by this principle, we aim to graduate competent dentists who actively contribute to improving healthcare standards and promoting health awareness in Amarah and across all governorates of our beloved Iraq. We pray to Almighty God for everyone's success in their academic and professional journeys.
dept.dentistry.vision: The Department of Dentistry at Al-Amarah University College strives to be a distinguished academic center in dental education and training, occupying an advanced position among peer departments at both the local and national levels.
dept.dentistry.mission: The department’s vision stems from the belief in the importance of combining solid scientific foundations with practical clinical application, ensuring the preparation of competent dentists capable of keeping pace with rapid scientific and technological developments in this vital field.
dept.dentistry.about: The Department of Dentistry at Al-Amarah University College is one of the vital medical departments dedicated to advancing the healthcare sector in the city of Amarah and the governorate as a whole. The department focuses on preparing dentists who possess a solid scientific foundation and advanced clinical skills, enabling them to provide high-quality therapeutic and preventive services in accordance with accredited scientific and ethical standards. In its educational programs, the department integrates theoretical knowledge with practical application through modern laboratories and teaching clinics that provide students with early hands-on training, building their confidence and expertise. Additionally, the department is committed to keeping pace with modern developments in dental sciences, encouraging students to engage in scientific research and stay updated on global advances in the field. The Department of Dentistry places special emphasis on community service by promoting oral health awareness and participating in educational and treatment campaigns, reflecting the college's mission to serve and develop the local community.
dept.pharmacy.name: Department of Pharmacy
dept.pharmacy.head_speech:
Dear students, my esteemed colleagues among the faculty and staff, and honorable visitors: I am deeply pleased, honored, and delighted to welcome you to the website of the Department of Pharmacy at Al-Amarah University College. 
 I am thrilled to welcome you all to this outstanding department, which brings together some of the finest minds and brightest talents in the field of pharmacy. Your decision to join us reflects your dedication to building a promising future in healthcare and pharmaceutical care. 
 In the Department of Pharmacy, we strive to provide an inspiring and stimulating learning environment that empowers you to discover your potential and develop your skills. We are committed to delivering comprehensive, practice-oriented educational programs that equip you with the academic knowledge and practical skills necessary to achieve excellence in the field. 
 Together, as one team, we will work to provide a fruitful and engaging educational experience. You will have the opportunity to engage with distinguished faculty members specialized in various branches of pharmacy, as well as opportunities to participate in rigorous research and development projects that enhance your skills and deepen your expertise.
 We are here to support you in reaching your academic and professional goals. We welcome your ideas, challenges, and aspirations, and we assure you of our continuous guidance and support. 
 I look forward to witnessing your growth and development throughout your studies in the Department of Pharmacy. I encourage you to make the most of all the resources and opportunities the department offers. 
 Once again, welcome, and I wish you an inspiring and successful academic journey! 
 Best regards.
dept.pharmacy.vision: Pharmacy is a vital and essential discipline that plays an effective role in societal development and improving people's quality of life. In this context, Al-Amarah University College offers the Department of Pharmacy as a specialized department aimed at equipping students with comprehensive knowledge and skills in pharmaceutical sciences. The department instills the ethics of the pharmacy profession, promotes the values of self-directed and lifelong learning, and conducts advanced scientific research that contributes to drug development and meets the community's healthcare needs. The department aspires to be a pioneer in pharmaceutical education both locally and globally, across academic and professional domains. The Department of Pharmacy at Al-Amarah University College serves as a platform empowering students to practice pharmacy professionally and make meaningful contributions to their community.
dept.pharmacy.mission: Achieving excellence in the field of pharmacy by training and developing distinguished pharmaceutical personnel, with a focus on all elements required to prepare highly competent graduates who possess deep knowledge across all aspects of pharmaceutical practice in its diverse domains. Providing outstanding pharmaceutical education through accredited academic programs to qualify highly competent pharmacists capable of contributing to the improvement of community healthcare and competing in professional markets nationally and regionally. The department is dedicated to instilling the ethics of the pharmacy profession, fostering values of self-directed and lifelong learning, and conducting advanced scientific research that contributes to the development of the pharmaceutical industry and meets societal health needs. The department aspires to be a pioneer in pharmaceutical education both locally and globally across academic and professional fields. It aims to ensure that its graduates are theoretically and practically distinguished by offering top-tier educational programs in the pharmaceutical and medical fields, with a strong emphasis on practical education to prepare leaders in pharmaceutical manufacturing and clinical pharmacy, providing the labor market with specialized scientific expertise in the field of pharmacy.
dept.pharmacy.goals: Graduating specialized professional pharmaceutical personnel and developing distinguished educational programs. Qualifying students by providing comprehensive, specialized educational programs that enable them to acquire the knowledge and skills necessary to practice pharmacy successfully. Empowering students to understand drug synthesis methods, mechanisms of action, chemical structures, and therapeutic applications. Striving to achieve international quality standards in pharmaceutical education and pursuing academic accreditation. Adopting advanced teaching methodologies. Enhancing the pharmacist's role in healthcare and disease prevention while building their scientific capabilities to fulfill this role effectively. Encouraging faculty and students to engage in scientific research across various pharmaceutical fields to advance knowledge and innovation. Exchanging scientific and research expertise with regional and international specialized universities and institutions. Providing state-of-the-art scientific laboratories built to internationally accredited specifications.
dept.pharmacy.about: The Department of Pharmacy is an academic, applied, and scientific department established in 2023 with the approval of the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research. Recognizing the urgent need in Maysan Governorate, Al-Amarah University College took it upon itself to establish the department. Following detailed feasibility studies and the provision of the required physical and human resources in accordance with the Ministry’s guidelines, official approval was granted under Ministry Letter No. 17663 to admit graduates of the preparatory school (Scientific and Biology branches) based on official admission regulations. Upon the successful completion of a five-year program, the department awards a Bachelor’s Degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences. The college has been keen to recruit specialized faculty members known for their scientific competence and research capability. Additionally, the college has fully equipped the department with the necessary instruments, equipment, and materials to ensure the smooth operation of the educational process, equipping students with essential skills and preparing them effectively for the labor market and community service.
